exposure: Fetal vertebroplacental ratio (VPR) multiples of the median (MoM)
outcome: Operative delivery for suspected fetal compromise (ODFC)
Composite perinatal outcome (CPO) at delivery (based on UA cord blood pH and base excess, 1-min and 5-min Apgar score, and neonatal intensive care unit admission)
cohort: The study included 161 women with a term (37-42 gestational weeks) singleton pregnancy and an appropriate-for-gestational-age (AGA) fetus, recruited before cervical dilatation reached 5 cm.
finding: No significant difference in VPR MoM or other Doppler variables (UA-PI MoM, MCA-PI MoM, VA-PI MoM, CPR MoM) was observed depending on the occurrence of ODFC or CPO at delivery, and adding these variables to clinical prediction models did not improve their accuracy.
mod_finding: No difference in VPR MoM or other Doppler variables was observed between cases which underwent operative delivery for suspected fetal compromise (ODFC) versus those which did not.
birth_weight: Appropriate-for-gestational-age (AGA) fetus, sonographic fetal weight estimation (EFW) performed.
gest_age: Term (37-42 gestational weeks) at recruitment; mean gestational age at delivery was 39.3 ± 1.0 weeks.
